claims.text: Lichtenberg nói chỉ có "tư duy đang diễn ra", không có "tôi"

sources.quote: Echoing the 18th century thinker, Georg Lichtenberg, Russell writes that Descartes should have, instead, stated “his ultimate premiss in the form ‘there are thoughts’.”
